description: Create or update a Zendesk organization in a single operation. If an organization with the same external_id already exists, it is updated. Otherwise, a new organization is created. Use when you need to ensure an organization exists without checking for duplicates first. Note: For updates, you must specify the external_id to match the existing organization. Name is not available as a matching criteria.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating or updating a Zendesk organization.

details.description: Any details about the organization, such as the address
details.human_parameter_description: Additional details or address information about the organization.
details.title: Details

domain_names.description: An array of domain names associated with this organization
domain_names.human_parameter_description: List of domain names associated with this organization for email routing.
domain_names.title: Domain Names

external_id.description: A unique external id to associate organizations to an external record. The id is case-insensitive (e.g., 'company1' and 'Company1' are considered the same). Use this for matching when updating an existing organization.
external_id.human_parameter_description: An optional identifier from your external system (CRM, etc.) used to match organizations. Case-insensitive.
external_id.title: External Id

group_id.description: New tickets from users in this organization are automatically put in this group
group_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the group that new tickets from users in this organization will be assigned to.
group_id.title: Group Id

name.description: A unique name for the organization. Required when creating a new organization. Note: Name is not available as a matching criteria for updates - use external_id or id instead.
name.human_parameter_description: The official name of the organization. This is required when creating a new organization. For updates, use external_id or id instead.
name.title: Name

notes.description: Any notes you have about the organization
notes.title: Notes

organization_fields.description: Custom fields for this organization. See custom organization fields documentation for available field definitions.
organization_fields.human_parameter_description: Custom field values for this organization (key-value pairs matching your custom field definitions).
organization_fields.title: Organization Fields

shared_comments.description: End users in this organization are able to comment on each other's tickets
shared_comments.human_parameter_description: Whether end users can comment on each other's tickets.
shared_comments.title: Shared Comments

shared_tickets.description: End users in this organization are able to see each other's tickets
shared_tickets.human_parameter_description: Whether end users can see each other's tickets.
shared_tickets.title: Shared Tickets

tags.human_parameter_description: List of tags to categorize this organization.
tags.title: Tags
